options: Twelve
Three

questions.q: What share of children were immunized before, and what did it fall to?
options: Over 99 percent, down to 95 percent
Over 85 percent, down to 70 percent
Over 90 percent, down to 80 percent

questions.explain: Over 95 percent were immunized; the rate fell to 92.4 percent in the school year beginning in 2025.

questions.q: What must a committee find for the U.S. to lose elimination status?
options: Vaccination coverage below 90 percent for two straight years
More than ten deaths in a single calendar year
Over 10,000 reported cases within any twelve-month period
Uninterrupted transmission for more than 12 months
questions.explain: The PAHO committee must determine uninterrupted transmission for more than 12 months.

options: It shows the vaccine is weakening as the virus evolves
It replaces the need for traditional case surveillance
It speeds up production of updated measles vaccines
It can distinguish endemic spread from travel-linked cases
questions.explain: Full sequences let scientists distinguish endemic circulation from travel-associated cases.
